title: Twelve points on four layers
notes: Twelve points inserted with M = 2: 12 on layer 0, 6 on layer 1, 3 on layer 2, 1 on layer 3, each layer about half the one below. The search for (1, 6) starts at K, d² 68 away, goes K, H, L, B, J down the upper layers, and finds J, F and B, the true three nearest, after 15 distance computations.
